open_issues.impact: Bare `swissknifeman doctor` no longer runs `<cli> doctor` of four modules; it runs the unique probes of every module.
open_issues.text: The doctor.fanout key was removed from configs/umbrella.json and configs/umbrella.schema.json (added in P12.1). The input did not decide this, but D79 replaces the fan-out.

open_issues.impact: V2 passes because it accepts rc<=1 and only checks that the units are present. Until P11.11 migrates these probes, a real run is always red.
open_issues.next: Module doctors (aicore, skiller) emit check-result/v1 with --json in P11.11.
open_issues.text: The aicore (aicore.ext) and skiller (skiller.environment) probes still print text, not check-result/v1. The aggregator reports them as synthetic fails (aicore.doctor, skiller.doctor), so real `swissknifeman doctor` exits 1 on this machine.

Design choices where the input was silent. A probe-level failure (not JSON, schema violation, crash, timeout) gives one `<unit>.doctor` fail and no per-id synthetics for that probe. With --unit/--category, only probes of the selected checks run. --category also filters returned documents by their own category. A probe's exit code is ignored if it printed valid JSON. A module without doctor in a --unit selection is listed as without doctor.

open_issues.impact: Inventory now covers both umbrella schemas.
open_issues.text: configs/schemas/umbrella-units.schema.json (from P12.1) was missing from configs/config-inventory.json and made test-config-inventory red. I added entries for it and for umbrella-doctor.schema.json.
The test scope check forbids module ids in umbrella.py, so the check-result URN is read from the aicore schema file and aicore is imported as `foundation`.
